title: The Footwashers
text: At a crossroads shrine, old women sit with basins and rags, washing pilgrims' feet. Their hands are gentle and their eyes are sharp. They ask, as they wash, for news of the road, and they listen very carefully to every answer.

options.label: Let them wash your feet, and rest a while in their gentle hands.

outcomes.text: They hum as they work. You leave with fresh feet and lighter hearts.

options.label: The best talker tells them the news of the road, and listens for what they give back.

outcomes.text: In low voices they give news back: what waits on the road ahead.

options.label: No time to stop. The road ahead will not wait.

outcomes.text: They bless you anyway, and it is a real blessing. The Leader's feet do not ache, and their scrapes close as they walk.
